capturedFrom: the original T-SQL object, deployed unchanged to a scratch SQL Server database with the fixed case's rows
review: Captured from the source engine, not derived independently. A reviewer checks each case's expected values against its label at step 5 (second review). Values are canonical: n: number, s: text, b: bit, d: date, t: timestamp (microseconds), x: bytes (hex), ∅: NULL.

cases.label: on the start date exactly (BETWEEN is inclusive): 60% of the list price (10.0000 x 0.60)
on the end date exactly (inclusive): 60% of the list price (10.0000 x 0.60)
one datetime tick (3 ms) after the end date: no period, NULL
one datetime tick before the start date: no period, NULL
open-ended period (EndDate NULL -> 9999-12-31) on 9999-12-30: 60% of an odd price (3.3333 x 0.60), kept to money's 4 places
a history row with no Product row: the inner join drops it, NULL
a product with no history: NULL
